environmentFinding.title: Shared local S3 test fixture (SeaweedFS 'ordinary' service) is capacity-exhausted at validation time
evidence: curl http://127.0.0.1:19333/dir/status -> Topology.Max=100, Topology.Free=0; tenant-01 collection has writables:[] (empty)

compose.factory-storage.local.yml caps the service at -master.volumeSizeLimitMB=64 -volume.max=100, i.e. ~6.4 GiB total across all 10 tenants, shared by every concurrent work-package worker and validator on this host
docker logs ezcorp-factory-storage-1001-factory-storage-ordinary-1 shows repeated 'No writable volumes and no free volumes left for tenant-01' starting ~2026-09-14T07:47Z

the worker's own real-S3 receipts for G7/G8/G9 are timestamped 2026-09-14T07:28-07:31Z (03:28-03:31 local), about 20-25 minutes before the exhaustion began, and are internally consistent (correct commit 2827c268a, clean tree, exit 0, exact expected counts)

a control run of a different work package's real-S3 suite (W04a's tests/postgres/factory-archive-writer.test.ts) fails identically right now, proving the exhaustion is session-wide and not introduced by W08
/tmp/ezcorp-validation-heavy.lock shows multiple other agents' heavy producers queued/holding concurrently (W06, W07 runs observed), consistent with swarm-wide contention driving the exhaustion
environmentFinding.conclusion: Not a W08 code defect. The adapter's own logic (conflict/resume/uncertain-recovery/multipart-abort/cancellation) is independently proven against an in-memory S3 double by the reproduced unit+pglite legs (30 tests, 306 assertions). What could not be independently re-confirmed by this validation is specifically: real network multipart byte movement at 256 MiB, and real SeaweedFS authorization/conditional-write semantics for the ten-tenant isolation count. Code review of release-s3-publication.ts and the test logic in factory-s3-publication-suite.ts shows the proofs are genuine (real SHA-256 over real bytes, real composite multipart ETag part-count parsing, real per-tenant credentials and real HTTP status capture) and not shortcut. Recommend the coordinator expand local SeaweedFS capacity (raise -volume.max/-master.volumeSizeLimitMB) or reserve a validation window, and have a validator re-run G7/G8/G9 once the shared fixture has headroom.
